briefdescription.para: Encodes a vector of pairs into a Node object.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes in a vector of pairs, where each pair contains a string and a vector of uint8_t values. It iterates over the input vector, assigning each pair's first element to the node as its key, and the second element to the node as its value. After processing all pairs, it returns the resulting Node object.

parameterdescription.para: The vector of pairs to encode into a Node object.

briefdescription.para: Decodes a Node object into a vector of pairs.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes in a const reference to a Node object and a reference to a std::vector of std::pair<std::string, std::vector<uint8_t>>. It first resizes the output vector based on the size of the input node. Then it checks if the "second" field in the node is a sequence and has more than zero elements. If not, it returns false. Otherwise, it iterates over the node fields, extracting the "first" and "second" values into the output vector.

parameterdescription.para: The Node object to be decoded.
The std::vector of pairs where the decoded data will be stored.
